title: Sharpie S-Gel Gel Pens, Black Barrel, Medium Point, Assorted Ink, 12 Count

comparisons.notes: Sharpie S-Gel 2096153, black barrel, 0.7mm medium, assorted ink (black/blue/red), dozen; delivery available

writeup: Woot has a dozen Sharpie S-Gel retractable gel pens for $5.19: four black, four blue and four red ink, all in black barrels with a 0.7mm medium point and contoured rubber grip. Staples sells the same 12-pack (2096153) for $17.99, so this works out to roughly 43 cents a pen. Limit 5 per customer.
